$comment: kun's MCP catalog — the DECLARED fleet, and the input health.sh counts. Claude Code does NOT read this file; setup.sh copies it to ~/.claude/mcp.json (also not read, but health.sh requires it and derives ROLE from it) and separately registers each entry for real via `claude mcp add-json -s user`. Pruned 2026-08-19 from 25 to 17: eight entries were unregistered not by oversight but because they are broken — design-system-analyzer (npm 404 (@yajihum/design-system-mcp)); memory-bank (npm 404 (@memory-bank/mcp-server)); algolia (local binary ~/.claude/bin/algolia-mcp is missing); gcloud (shell wrapper, speaks no JSON-RPC — not an MCP server); keychain (shell wrapper, speaks no JSON-RPC — not an MCP server); vercel (deliberate dedup — the claude.ai Vercel connector already covers it); neon (case-collides with the live user-scope `Neon`; wrong transport besides); postgres (@bytebase/dbhub — wrong driver, redundant with Neon). Every remaining entry documents a server that is live at user scope today. Asymmetry left deliberately unfixed: Neon, browser, browser-headed and cloudflare-docs are live at user scope but absent here; adding them changes project_mcp again for no gain. (higgs left user scope on 2026-09-28 — its skill runs the higgsfield CLI and says never to detour through the MCP; 1 call in 60 days.) The seven entries flagged $skipRegistration on 2026-09-28 were removed from registration on 2026-09-26; the flag stops an interactive setup.sh from re-adding them. The per-server `description` field is kun's own annotation and is stripped (del(.description)) before registration — it is not part of the MCP config schema.
